title: crepidium decumbens
intro: Crepidium decumbens, commonly known as the terrestrial orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the treatment of various health issues, and is known to provide health benefits such as lowering blood pressure and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Crepidium decumbens include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect cells from oxidative damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
